entries.zh: 无人接手；货物无人承买。
entries.en: to find no taker; no buyer for the goods.
entries.notes: L 首尾均残（no parecer el daño [残] … el kurto al kurto 讹误），义据 H/M「無下手」与 R 残文 no aben [残] comprador de la cosa 定。

entries.en: to be no match for others; not as good as other people.
entries.notes: L「no parecer hombre」偏「不像个人」，与 H/M/R 三栏（不如人）语意有出入，释义从汉字与对音。

entries.zh: 见却；拒绝接受（所赠所付）。
entries.en: to decline, to refuse (what is offered or paid).
to refuse, to turn down.
to be unwilling; not to be reconciled to it.
to refuse what is offered.
shameless; to have no sense of shame.
entries.notes: L「no sauet（sabe）los que conviene」偏「不知分寸」，H/M「無面目」偏「无耻」，取汉字一栏为本义。

entries.en: to have no learning; unlettered.
cannot be settled or reckoned; one cannot tell (what tomorrow brings).
entries.notes: L 谓「不知明日事」，H/M「袂了得」谓「无法了结」，义近而未全合，且 M 次字 T99 污损。

entries.en: not to take one's own measure; to overrate oneself.
unfathomable; beyond guessing.
to be unacquainted; unfamiliar with someone.
to have no answer; to be at a loss for words.
entries.notes: H 作「口」而 M 读 chiũ，与「口」常音不合，疑原字为喙/嘴；释义从 L「no saber responder」与 H。

entries.zh: 一问三不知；什么都不懂。
entries.en: to know nothing of what one is asked; to be utterly ignorant.
entries.notes: H 有 [疑:罕/寧]，M「chay chay」与「罕」音不合，四栏不能互证，仅存大意。

entries.en: little does one know; to be quite unaware (that …).
entries.notes: M 末音仅作 q，据 H「知」补读，属残损/缩写推断。

entries.zh: 货物无人承买；无人接手。
entries.en: no buyer comes forward for the merchandise; to find no taker.
not to succeed in it; to fail to bring it off.
to have no knowledge or experience; ignorant of the world.
entries.notes: L「no se conosce el.」句意残断，义据 H/M「無見識」定。

entries.en: the effect is not obtained; the matter cannot be brought to completion.
entries.notes: H/M「完轉」为罕见复合，据 L「no se consigue el efecto」定「不能成事」义。

entries.en: to be nowhere to be found; without a trace.
not to be compared; of no comparable standing.
cannot be compared; past comparison.
entries.notes: M 末二音 mim dixa 不可解，疑为旁注；L「ome dir」亦讹。
